open_points.subject: A03-2 project correction versus A04-3
open_points.text:
The facts a correction does not edit — identity, status, marks, instants,
   request id — are not part of it and do not change by it.
open_points.question: Does an accepted project correction that changes editable facts change the project's last-changed instant, as A04-3 requires, or leave every instant unchanged, as A03 rule 3 requires? The text must exclude the last-changed instant from A03's unchanged facts while preserving the created instant, or change A04-3.
options: Exclude the last-changed instant from A03's unchanged facts; keep the created instant unchanged and set last-changed to now.
Leave every project instant unchanged on correction, contrary to A04-3 and State 1's revision/time pair.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the created instant as unchanged but move the last-changed instant with the revision, and rewrite A03-2 accordingly.

witness.initial: An active project has revision 3, created instant C and last-changed instant L.
events: The owner submits an accepted correction that changes the project's display name against revision 3.
outcomes: A03 rule 3 leaves both C and L unchanged.
A04-3 moves the revision to 4 and sets the last-changed instant to the current instant, while C remains unchanged.
witness.observer: The owner reading the corrected project, and the check asserting A03-2 or A04-3, sees whether the last-changed instant moved.

open_points.subject: A04-3 Required test 11
open_points.text:
a correction that
   changes a Customer, and a mark that restricts it, each move the Customer's
   revision by exactly one
open_points.question: Must Required test 11 also show that each Customer change sets the Customer's last-changed instant to the current instant, as A04-3 requires? As written, it demonstrates only the Customer revision half of that invariant.
options: Extend the test to assert the Customer's last-changed instant for both correction and restriction.
Narrow A04-3 so its last-changed guarantee applies only to Projects.
open_points.default_guess: Extend the test to assert that Customer revision and last-changed instant move together.

witness.initial: A Customer has revision 2 and last-changed instant L.
events: The owner accepts a Customer correction against revision 2.
The resulting test observes the revision but does not inspect the last-changed instant.
outcomes: The implementation sets revision 3 and changes last-changed to the operation's current instant.
The implementation sets revision 3 but leaves last-changed at L; the stated Required test still passes.
witness.observer: A caller reading the Customer and any later test of the State 1 revision/time-pair guarantee sees the difference.

open_points.subject: A04 timestamp reading for a correction and its audit entry
open_points.text: sets its last-changed instant to the current instant
open_points.question: How many UTC wall-clock readings does one accepted correction take when it writes both the record's last-changed instant and A14's audit-entry instant, and must those two stored instants be identical?
options: Take one wall-clock reading for the operation and use it for both the record and its audit entry.
Take a separate reading for each written instant, allowing the audit instant to differ from the record's last-changed instant.
open_points.default_guess: Take one reading after acceptance is decided and use it for every fresh UTC instant written by that correction.

witness.initial: A project correction is accepted and must update the project and write one audit entry in the same transaction.
events: Registry obtains the current time and stores the correction and audit entry.
outcomes: The project last-changed instant and audit-entry instant are identical because one reading supplies both.
The instants can differ because Registry reads the clock separately for each field.
witness.observer: The owner comparing the project card with its audit entry sees the difference.

open_points.subject: A12 Required test 6 stale-version sequence
open_points.text:
each of the owner's
   actions stating the version before it is refused and changes nothing.
open_points.question: Does “the version before it” mean the version before the already accepted change, used in a later replay, or the version immediately before the owner action itself? The required event order must say that the change is first accepted with the current version and that a subsequent action using that now-stale version is refused.
options: For each case, accept the change with version v, then submit the relevant owner action again with v and require refusal without change.
Require the original owner action stating the current pre-change version v to be refused, which conflicts with A12 rule 3.
open_points.default_guess: Interpret it as a second action after the accepted change, using the former version that has become stale.

open_points.subject: A21 security-review conclusion about complete invariant coverage
open_points.text:
and Required tests were added to A02, A03, A04, A08, A09, A10, A12
and A22 and restated in A11 and A22 so that each invariant is shown whole:
open_points.question: How can A21 claim that every invariant is shown whole when A04 Required test 11 does not show the Customer last-changed part of A04-3 and A03-2 conflicts with A04-3 over the project's last-changed instant? The review conclusion must be revised or the underlying rules and tests completed first.
options: Resolve A03-2 versus A04-3 and extend A04's Required test, then retain the conclusion.
Qualify the conclusion to identify the invariant portions that remain unshown.
open_points.default_guess: Fix the contradiction and test coverage, then rerun and restate the A21 review conclusion.

open_points.subject: A09 service-rights policy
open_points.text:
Every service token names one service; Registry knows from its own release
   which operations that service may call and the highest disclosure class it
   may receive (R0-26, R0-27).
open_points.rule:
У значения, которое читает генерируемый код, ровно три пути; путь
выбирается по тому, что это за значение, и у значения один дом (§15.4).
open_points.question: The passage must name the compliant path by which the service-to-operations-and-highest-class policy reaches generated code—normally an imported data-provider policy constant, with closed individual vocabularies remaining model enumerations—instead of saying only that Registry knows it from its release.
